name: woocommerce/customers-query
label: Query customers
description: Find registered and guest customers by ID, user ID, name or email, with their order count, total spent and activity dates, as WooCommerce Analytics counts them. A registered customer appears once Analytics has recorded them: when they register, order, or visit signed in, or the store imports historical data. Guest orders with the same email count as one guest. Core fields leave out names, usernames, emails, phone numbers and addresses.

include.description: Return only these customer IDs, up to 100. Without per_page, they come back in one page.

user_id.description: Return only the registered customer with this WordPress user ID, such as the customer_id of an order.

search.description: With search_by name, return only customers whose name contains this text. With search_by email, return only the customer with this exact email address.

per_page.description: Customers per page. Defaults to 10, or to the number of IDs in include.

customers.description: Returned customers for the current page.

id.description: Analytics customer ID. Guests have one too.

user_id.description: WordPress user ID. Only registered customers have one.

order_count.description: Orders in the statuses that Analytics counts.

total_spent.description: Decimal amount of those orders after refunds, in the store currency.

total_pages.description: Total number of result pages available for the current query.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items requested per page.

total.description: Number of customers that match the query.
